name: Bopmigo
author: Bopmigo

sections.description:
Bopmigo gives your visitors a simple way to tell you what went wrong, or what they’d like, right on the page where it happened. And it lets you start the conversation too.

  • People report problems and ideas in their own words.
  • When something important is missing, Bopmigo asks a short follow-up, so you can act on the first report.
  • Similar reports are grouped, so you see what affects the most people.
  • Reply from your Bopmigo inbox, and the person sees your answer right on your site.
  • Message people on your site before they report anything: a customer who stopped halfway, a client reviewing a new site, a tester who went quiet. Their replies land in your inbox.
  • Prefer email? Get every report by email.

Setup takes a couple of minutes:

  1. Create a Bopmigo account and add your site.
  2. Copy your site’s install snippet.
  3. In WordPress, go to Settings > Bopmigo, paste it and save.

Third-party service

This plugin loads the Bopmigo widget from https://bopmigo.com/widget.js on the pages of your site, and the widget sends the reports your visitors choose to submit, and their replies to your messages, to Bopmigo. Nothing is loaded or sent until you save a project ID in Settings > Bopmigo.

  • Service: https://bopmigo.com
  • Terms of service: https://bopmigo.com/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://bopmigo.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings > Bopmigo.
  3. Paste your install snippet or project ID from Bopmigo and click Save.
  4. In Bopmigo, make sure your site’s address is listed for the site, so reports are accepted.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Bopmigo account?

Yes. Pro and Team start with a 7-day trial, with no card needed.

Who can I message?

Visitors who have sent feedback before, on the same browser. To message signed-in members by name, add one line from the Bopmigo docs that tells Bopmigo who is signed in.

How do I turn the button off?

Clear the field in Settings > Bopmigo and save, or deactivate the plugin.
